method: Blind semantic verification: each proposal is shown to an independent model with only the claim and the venue's own words around it (no author reasoning, no status), twice with different models and different batch compositions. Pass A: Claude Opus. Pass B: Claude Sonnet (a Fable pass was attempted and failed on a usage limit). Both are the same model family as the author of the proposals, so errors can be correlated; seeded wrong claims measure whether they catch what they should. Verdicts are evidence for a person, never an approval.

items.claim: Free parking is available on site for visitors.
Free Blue Badge parking is available on site.
No dogs anywhere in the park or the museum.
The zoo is too steep for pushchairs.
The main courtyard (with the toilets and baby changing) is closed on Mondays and Tuesdays outside school holidays.
The Garden is a hands-on play gallery for 2 to 6 year olds.
Wonderlab is the free interactive gallery for children 7 to 14.
Bubble Explorers: £4.50 per person, free for children 5 and under.
Lifts in the Darwin Centre and the Mammals Hall are permanently out of order.
No step-free access to the museum's upper floors.
A play space for 0 to 5 year olds (free with an Entry ticket; book a 45 minute session).
Park open daily from 7am until dusk; museum open every day 10am to 4.30pm.
The Creepy Crawlies Gallery has closed permanently.
Wheelchair accessible toilets and a Changing Places toilet.
